items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: And I had Cascaro on tuba.

ctx.x: Let me tell you a little story about the Chinamen. I had them on bass pedal and had them on guitar all the time, you know. And it seemed like I needed more tuba players. I only had two at the time, you understand? Then I got Lawyer Cannon, May Street, and I had to get five tuba players anyway. So, here comes young Buffalo Bill, a fellow by the name O'Brien, for the Wild West Show. Well, they found out about me, you understand? They come down to shame me. And I had Cascaro on tuba.
